title: Tôi có thể mua sạc dự phòng ở đâu?
englishTitle: Where can I buy a power bank?
pronunciation: Toi co the mua sac du phong o dau
summary: For finding a portable battery before your phone dies during a ride, tour, or long walk.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Ask with your low-battery screen visible. Staff may point to a phone shop, mini-mart, mall floor, or charger shelf.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show a photo of a power bank if the word does not land. The answer is usually a nearby shop or shelf, not a long explanation.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Tôi có thể mua asks where can I buy; sạc dự phòng means power bank; ở đâu asks where.

breakdown.vietnamese: Tôi có thể mua sạc dự phòng ở đâu?
breakdown.english: Where can I buy a power bank?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Wi-Fi-password and SIM-card cards help if the same shop can solve more than battery.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at cafes, hotels, SIM shops, malls, airports, convenience stores, and tour stops when battery matters.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Check cable type and charging speed before paying; the cheapest battery may not help your phone in time.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Dead-battery, charger, charge-here, Wi-Fi, and SIM cards cover the rest of the phone-and-power problem.
